description: CR 702.36b a devoid creature with a black mana cost may not block a creature with fear
note: Wire Surgeons prints fear, standing in for the Haskell test's granted fear. The falsifier for reading the blocker's printed colour: Slaughter Drone costs {1}{B} but devoid (CR 702.114a) makes it colourless, so bob is not asked to block (an unscheduled block prompt would fail the run).
